name: ObjectivesComponentServerFacet_SetObjectiveAutoPinning
summary: The client's objective auto-pinning flag set: the shared 16-byte head (two u64 BE) then a prefix-varint count (<= 36) and that many bool bytes. 17..53 byte body, C2S. A live channel-0 record matches the writer/reader layout field for field.
purpose: Tell the server which journal objective slots are auto-pinned. The server changes the objectives replicated state; the Objectives family has no reply for this request.

created_when: the player toggles auto-pinning for one or more tracked objectives
lifecycle.if_absent: the server never learns the auto-pinning flags and cannot replay them

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint 95 2a, i.e. type_dec 2709. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head (FUN_1414dbca0, reader FUN_14150e670). Measured 0x180f8d4e573697c6 in the live channel-0 body. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0xa95: 'head'.

fields.name: field_b
fields.note: Second head u64. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0xa95: 'head'.

fields.name: auto_pinning_flags
fields.note: Prefix-varint count (stated <= 36) then count bool bytes. meanings.md 'The Journal families' row 0xa95: 'head + varint(len <= 36) + N bool bytes'. The live channel-0 body carries count 36 (0x24) and 36 flag bytes.
